programme.title: 百万美国公主 2 #3
programme.desc: 目睹集美貌、财富和权力于一身的女人们芭芭拉赫顿、克拉拉沃德和凯萨琳「基克」卡文迪许的悲惨故事,她们嫁给了欧洲贵族,但最终被社会、家庭和她们所期望的幸福结局所唾弃。

programme.title: 百万美国公主 2 #4
programme.desc: 探索三位美国女性对英国时尚、室内设计甚至国会所产生的影响。南茜阿斯特、南希兰开斯特和宝莲德罗斯柴尔德都有不同的出发点,但每位都想出人头地。

programme.title: 百万美国公主 2 #1
programme.desc: 认识三位蜕变成现实生活中公主的女演员。一看葛丽丝凯莉、格洛丽亚斯旺森和丽塔海华斯从荷里活皇室一跃成为欧洲贵族后所带来无与伦比的魅力。

programme.title: 自然保护区 #2
programme.desc: 从落基山脉到太平洋,英属哥伦比亚是生物多样性的瑰宝!在辽阔大地追随灰熊的霸气身影。这是一片庄严且神圣、亟需我们守护的原始荒野!

programme.title: 自然保护区 #3
programme.desc: 生命自会找到出路!随风漂流而来的物种,让加勒比海成为全球生物多样性热点。深入探索这些迷人而脆弱的翡翠生态系,感受海岛生机。

programme.title: 自然保护区 #4
programme.desc: 穿越时空!探索昆士兰古老的湿地与原生雨林。这里栖息著史前时代的幸存者,带您踏上一场通往热带澳洲起源的生命活力之旅。

programme.title: 自然保护区 #5
programme.desc: 国土虽小,震撼巨大!哥斯大黎加拥有全球 5% 的物种。从山巅到海岸,亲身体会守护这座丰富生命圣殿对地球是多么至关重要。

programme.title: 大白鲨的秘密
programme.desc: 鲨鱼是怪物吗?还是已经被妖魔化?这部纪录片探讨大白鲨本性背后的真相。

programme.title: 创造之岛
programme.desc: 在南太平洋一个偏远群岛的丛林中,一位生物学家正尝试做著查理斯达尔文和恩斯特迈尔的未竟之事: 在新物种创造过程中捕捉进化的身影。怀艾伯特在所罗门群岛即将有一个惊人的发现,但一个危机慢慢逼近。

programme.title: 消失的录影带 2 #3
programme.desc: 通过警察的音频和视频,还有当地及国家新闻报道,审 视2002年华盛顿特区的狙击手袭击事件。狙击手为期三周的恐怖统治引发了美国史上最激烈、最复杂的搜捕行动之一。

programme.title: 消失的录影带 2 #4
programme.desc: 透过罕见的档案录像审视民权社运人士麦尔坎X的迅速崛起和悲剧下场。

programme.title: 消失的录影带 2 #5
programme.desc: 透过档案录像见证柯林顿总统被弹劾当天的故事。

programme.title: 空中战士 10 #4
programme.desc: 了解P-47雷霆式战斗机如何在德国和太平洋地区制霸空战,还能同时对地面造成破坏。

programme.title: 空中战士 10 #5
programme.desc: 从夜间追踪任务到救援行动,了解MH-6「小鸟」直升机如何在其他大型机体中赢得一席之地。

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts"nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show" These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud

programme.title: The Blue Realm

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 2 #1
programme.desc: 在眼镜蛇道场赢得18岁以下全谷空手道锦标赛冠军后,强尼开始质疑自己的道场哲学,并与他一位故人打交道。丹尼尔寻找正确的方式来应付眼镜蛇道场的统治。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 2 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼尔开始教导第一批空手道学生,他怀疑自己是否能接替宫城先生的衣钵。在一个意想不到的来源帮助下,强尼发明了一些邪道训练方法。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 2 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼尔全力以赴为宫城道招募新生。强尼反省生命中一些重要的关系,并以自己的方式回应丹尼尔的努力宣传。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 2 #4
programme.desc: 丹尼尔再次尝试推广宫城道,并以熟悉的方式获得指导。强尼对克里斯的背景越发生疑。一名新的眼镜蛇道场学生挑战米格尔并与艾莎成为朋友,而罗比则重温宁愿忘记的过去。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 2 #5
programme.desc: 丹尼尔努力帮助新生学习。米格尔交了新友,而强尼则尝试修复一段关系。两个道场之间的张力已达到临界点。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 2 #6
programme.desc: 丹尼尔的学生们上了如何克服怨恨的一课。强尼离开道场一段时间,而克里斯则发挥他的影响力。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 2 #7
programme.desc: 为了让学生们做好准备,丹尼尔尝试一些新的训练方法。米格尔活学活用。强尼做出一个影响眼镜蛇道场既艰难但关键的决定。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 2 #8
programme.desc: 丹尼尔努力与阿曼达修补关系,而强尼则打开约会应用程式的大门。米格尔、萨曼莎、罗比和朵利的相遇让事情变得复杂起来。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 2 #9
programme.desc: 强尼小心翼翼地尝试不大会成功的恋爱,而丹尼尔和阿曼达则享受浪漫的约会夜。尝试让两个道场的学生聚会却适得其反,青少年间的敌意不断升级。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 2 #10
programme.desc: 这是西谷高中开学的第一天,但​​两个道场之间的张力并没有随著夏天的结束而缓和。丹尼尔和强尼之间的竞争到了白热化阶段。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 3 #1
programme.desc: 米格尔命悬一线,罗比失踪。丹尼尔与强尼名誉扫地,社区仍为「西谷高中大乱斗」的后续动荡不安。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 3 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼尔与强尼放下成见,联手寻找罗比。米格尔的康复之路充满未知,克里斯试图召回托莉重返道馆。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 3 #3
programme.desc: 丹尼尔的事业因形象受损而陷入低潮,并收到收购提议;强尼四处筹钱,为米格尔的手术奔走。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 3 #4
programme.desc: 丹尼尔前往日本洽谈重要会议,重回冲绳,寻找能让事业与人生重回正轨的启示。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 3 #5
programme.desc: 在冲绳,丹尼尔重逢旧友与旧敌,意外获得新的领悟。同时,两大道馆的宿怨持续升温。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 3 #6
programme.desc: 米格尔帮助强尼打造完美的社交媒体形象;克里斯积极招募新成员,丹尼尔与阿曼达试图关闭眼镜蛇道馆。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 3 #7
programme.desc: 丹尼尔陪伴受创的珊,修复父女关系。强尼计划成立新道馆,却苦于想不到一个酷炫的名字。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 3 #8
programme.desc: 得知本年度全谷空手道大赛被取消后,三位师父齐聚市议会,努力争取比赛继续举行。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 3 #9
programme.desc: 圣诞节将至,爱情与和解的气息弥漫。丹尼尔与米格尔找到共同点,眼镜蛇学徒展开一场秘密行动。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 3 #10
programme.desc: 圣诞派对上旧伤复发、恩怨再起。克里斯的学生发动暴力袭击,新的背叛与同盟由此诞生。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 4 #1
programme.desc: 强尼与丹尼尔合并道馆,但彼此截然不同的教学风格立刻产生冲突。克里斯试图说服一名前搭档重返眼镜蛇道馆。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 4 #2
programme.desc: 强尼学习防守策略,丹尼尔则尝试主动进攻。阿曼达直面托莉。新来的肯尼在学校遭到霸凌。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 4 #3
programme.desc: 在罗比的鼓励下,肯尼试图成为眼镜蛇道馆的学生;同时,强尼鼓励珊相信自己,勇敢踏出一步。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 4 #4
programme.desc: 克里斯将泰瑞带回眼镜蛇道馆,但这位旧伙伴并不想重蹈覆辙。强尼对丹尼尔指导米格尔感到心生嫉妒。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 4 #5
programme.desc: 当强尼与丹尼尔同意进行一场「胜者全拿」的师父对决时,他们的道馆——以及脆弱的同盟——濒临瓦解。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 4 #6
programme.desc: 即将到来的比赛规则出现重大变动,强尼急忙为「鹰牙道馆」寻找新学员。托莉不得不向拉鲁索一家请求帮助。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 4 #7
programme.desc: 丹尼尔邀请安东尼加入宫城道,却发现自己其实并不如想像中了解儿子。米格尔得知强尼与卡门之间的真相。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 4 #8
programme.desc: 米格尔与珊期待参加青少年舞会,却因另一对情侣的突然出现而生变。泰瑞将强尼引诱至一个熟悉的地方。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 4 #9
programme.desc: 一年一度的全谷空手道大赛正式展开,多个道馆为总冠军而战,同时清算私人恩怨。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 4 #10
programme.desc: 比赛以震撼结局落幕,后续影响让所有参赛者措手不及,两位冠军的未来充满变数。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #1
programme.desc: 强尼劳伦斯在输掉全谷空手道锦标赛34年后,决定重开眼镜蛇道场,而他学校的对手丹尼尔拉鲁索则经营著一家成功的汽车公司。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #2
programme.desc: 丹尼尔沮丧地发现全新的眼镜蛇道场已经开业。强尼了解到他的道场真正开始教学前必须通过几项安全要求。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #3
programme.desc: 米格尔帮助强尼在网上宣传眼镜蛇道场。丹尼尔同意在万圣节舞会上担任监护人,以便可以看顾女儿。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #4
programme.desc: 罗比与父亲关系紧张。强尼因米格尔受伤而计划关闭眼镜蛇道场。萨曼莎和凯勒的关系跌至谷底。被破坏的广告板让丹尼尔绷紧。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #5
programme.desc: 眼镜蛇道场接收第二位学生。丹尼尔有一个复杂的计划来报复强尼。米格尔在午休时为捍卫萨曼莎而对抗凯勒。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #6
programme.desc: 强尼的道场课吸引一群不合的人,而他心怀不轨的儿子罗比则找到一份新工作。萨曼莎在科学课上结识一位新朋友。丹尼尔激发了一个意想不到的人对空手道的兴趣。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #7
programme.desc: 强尼得知眼镜蛇道场被禁止参加全谷锦标赛后跟市议会对质。米格尔约会萨曼莎。罗比向丹尼尔学习,而他的伙伴则策划抢劫拉鲁索汽车公司。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #8
programme.desc: 强尼为他的眼镜蛇道场学生准备下一届全谷空手道锦标赛,他也反过来受启发去改过自新。丹尼尔还不知道他新学生的背景。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #9
programme.desc: 路易的鲁莽行为逼使强尼和丹尼尔回忆往事。眼镜蛇道场学生密谋对受欢迎的孩子进行报复。米格尔对萨曼莎慢慢失去耐性。

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #1

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #3

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #4

programme.title: 眼镜蛇道馆 #5

programme.title: 无名记忆 (第2季) #21
programme.desc: 法尔萨斯的邻国玛葛达鲁西亚的国王莫名陷入昏睡。缇娜夏前去拜访时却发现自称代理人的露琪亚占据王位,且她的魔力不输魔女。缇娜夏怕引起战斗,决定先回国商讨对策。当他们发现露琪亚就是「封闭之森魔女」露克芮札,奥斯卡却遭受攻击,阿卡西亚也被抢走了。

programme.title: 无名记忆 (第2季) #22
programme.desc: 深受奥斯卡和缇娜夏信赖的瓦尔托,曾在某段历史中担任法尔萨斯的魔法师长并经历了无数次人生。在某次强国塔伊利之神,伊力提鲁迪亚袭击法尔萨斯而让他痛失挚爱蜜菈莉丝后,他就使用艾尔特利亚试图改写历史。防备著露琪亚的缇娜夏前往玛葛达鲁西亚进行调查。

programme.title: 无名记忆 (第2季) #23
programme.desc: 玛葛达鲁西亚和铎洱达尔终于开战。当缇娜夏对上露琪亚,奥斯卡赶来传达瓦尔托提供的情报。露琪亚体内的是玛葛达鲁西亚的国王,露克芮札的灵魂则被关在「忘却之镜」中。将露琪亚交给奥斯卡对付,缇娜夏则去破坏「忘却之镜」,但这场战斗的终结不过是段插曲。

programme.title: 无名记忆 (第2季) #24
programme.desc: 瓦尔托为了避免挚爱,蜜菈莉丝的灵魂因历史走到尽头而被解体,拿铎洱达尔当筹码逼缇娜夏破坏艾尔特利亚。缇娜夏虽明白魔法球为瓦尔托带来的痛苦和其影响力,仍感到犹豫不已。她将后事托付给奥斯卡后抱著蓝色魔法球跳入无言之湖,并回到她最幸福的那一刻…

programme.title: 海贼王 #13
programme.desc: 为了营救艾斯,白胡子海贼团与海军本部、七武海在马林福特爆发激战,而鲁夫也率领越狱犯加入战场。鲁夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯却为了保护他而被赤犬击杀,白胡子亦战死。战争最终在红发杰克的介入下落幕。经此一战,鲁夫与伙伴们决定分别修行两年后再会。

programme.desc: 在2月14日的情人节,校内男女都散发出坐立难安的氛围,对路人男的白石来说当天本该是与他无缘的平日。然而他入座后却惊讶地发现桌子里居然有一片心型的巧克力饼干!白石忍不住重新确认了五次,头还撞到桌子,此时久保出现在他面前。

programme.title: 久保同学不放过我 #5
programme.desc: 在3月的某一天,白石注意到3月14日在月历被标记为「白色情人节」,让他想起了情人节在桌子中发现的巧克力饼干。平时容易被店员忽略的白石下定决心购买一份情人节回礼。在白色情人节当天,他将久保叫到走廊。

programme.title: 久保同学不放过我 #6
programme.desc: 某天白石身后的一位女孩捡到他弄掉的手帕,叫住了他。平时弄掉物品经常会被直接无视的白石对此感到不可思议。他后来偶然得知那女孩是久保的堂妹沙贵、在书店遇到的女店员是久保的姊姊明菜。在另一天,白石在上学时迟到,他察觉从教室出来的久保样子有些奇怪。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #5
programme.desc: 阿久津在魔界上司丽兹的训练下终于获得了信心。为了使莉莉堕落,他开始采取行动。对于以闪闪动人的帅气模式诱惑自己的阿久津,莉莉亦以软萌女主角的模式反击。阿久津看穿莉莉的所有攻击,并逐一闪避过去……处于压倒性劣势的莉莉,决定要孤注一掷。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使与恶魔共舞 #6
programme.desc: 莉莉一整晚都未能睡著,因为她脑里全都是昨晚和阿久津之间所发生的事。不胜睡魔的她,在上课时不禁打起了瞌睡。阿久津甚至还出现在了她的睡梦中。在这场如恋爱游戏般的梦境中,她认为她或许能找到攻略阿久津的线索……莉莉打算推进游戏中的故事,然而……

programme.title: 海贼王 #13

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地的见证人,100篇令人万万想不到的剧本,配以崭新的拍摄和剪接手法,滋润都市人的心灵,带来生命的觉醒。

programme.title: 如果还有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面对著生命中突然而至的苦难与罪困,在天灾、人祸、病困及罪咎中,有人因为痛苦不堪而选择轻生,但亦都有人在挣扎过后,生命变得更有焦点,更清晰人生的方向。影音使团制作队跨越中港台两地,拍摄对象包括:台湾风灾救灾者、饱历风霜的一代影星、蒙古车祸生还者、从死亡边缘活过来的反派演员、与癌同行的历奇教练等。藉著十个见证者的亲身经历,让观众明白他们如何靠著基督信仰跨过生命中最难熬过的难关。

programme.title: 葛培理牧师特辑
programme.desc: 节目记录葛培理布道团最新福音事工,并葛培理牧师70年来布道的足迹及对世界各地的贡献,让我们面对不同的世情,仍然把握机会传福音。

programme.title: 圣地流动教室-以色列破谜之旅
programme.desc: 通晓中西方历史、文学、艺术、民间传说的学者吴宗文牧师,以及主持梁艺龄,透过镜头带著电视观众,去到圣地各站游历,呈现出新旧约的《圣经》典故、历史文献的记载、相关的犹太传说和传统习俗,而更重要是从耶稣和初期信徒的记载,带出人生的重要特质,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 地球大神秘

programme.title: 福音电影: 最危险人物
programme.desc: 「一代贼王」叶继欢今晨于玛丽医院羁留病房因癌症病逝,终年55岁。 这个曾经手持AK47在街上乱枪扫射、令人闻风丧胆的贼王在被捕、越狱后再犯案。一次偷渡回港时,中枪被捕,成为半身瘫痪的囚犯。 叶继欢于2004年归信耶稣,2010年更亲笔回信给《天使心》。 今天,小编在整理叶继欢的书信时,发现了这一句话: 「最后,我想讲嘅就系,主令我改变。」

programme.desc: 有人说,人生是一场戏,在人生的过程中,寻找有时、碰壁有时、迷失有时、觉醒有时,说真的,这些起承转合比真正的电影情节更精彩,每一个「你」,都是天父特别设计的人生剧本主角。 今天,我们的世界充满了末世风情,醉生梦死、迷失自我了结生命的悲剧每天上演,创世电视藉100个见证故事挽救生命,100位来自世界各地

programme.title: 如果还有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面对著生命中突然而至的苦难与罪困,在天灾、人祸、病困及罪咎中,有人因为痛苦不堪而选择轻生,但亦都有人在挣扎过后,生命变得更有焦点,更清晰人生的方向。影音使团制作队跨越中港台两地,拍摄对象包括:台湾风灾救灾者、饱历风霜的一代影星、蒙古车祸生还者、从死亡边缘活过来的反派演员、与癌同行的历

programme.title: 世界生命之道:邝保亮牧师
programme.desc: 邝保亮牧师,与父亲邝健雄牧师一同于新加坡带领9千多人的教会,承传父亲热心布道的精神,继续以激励人心的资讯,挑战我们成为为主摆上的门徒!

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
隆行天下之重走八千里路云和月普
手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 不丹人相信, 他们的木面具能连结神与人, 令人正直善良地生活 蕴含不丹精神和灵魂的木面具代表著神的形象, 是不丹人的重要节庆策秋节中 宣扬佛教教义的表演里不可或缺的元素

programme.title: 仨心友行粤
programme.desc: 敏之对巴生谷的房地产甚感兴趣，遂偕同高Ling、嘉欣组成「睇楼团」，一探当地楼市情报。某大型屋苑设有不同主题区域，中心由一个湖泊贯通，姊妹们初尝「游船河去睇楼」。精心设计的大宅，拥有宽阔主人房、梦幻浴室，教人心动；高Ling却对椅子情有独钟？敏之更透露有计划安排儿子到当地读书！来到吉隆坡蕉赖，三姊妹行逛夜市尽情「扫街」，品尝菜头粿、炒粿条、阿榜糕等地道小吃。她们口中的「辣死你阿妈」又是甚么美食？

programme.title: 港产旅行团粤PG
programme.desc: Ben Sir跟着年轻女拍档淑雅、祖仪向大刀屻进发！不断上落的山路梯级，Ben Sir人到中年可「顶得住」？放心，有骨科医生伴行，除了建议行山杖宜选直柄，顺道传授登山姿势，以免伤及腰、膝。情人节临近，祖仪获林正峰安排体贴惊喜。亲身体验酒店宅度假，享用女生至爱下午茶、泳池边日光浴，加上主题拍照服务，祖仪顿感心花怒放。Ben Sir推介情侣赏夜景秘地，颖彤与黄庭锋实试拍拖指数，摸黑谈心都可以好浪漫！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 谷主凯文参加了十公里街跑后就爱上跑步，因此「开谷」与拍档分享跑步的乐趣。人类学家认为跑步是人类的生存技能，凯文找到的资料还提到古时人类是以长跑传递讯息，马拉松的起源相传亦与此有关。谷主们讨论本港跑步兴起的原因，汛文觉得跑步能让人享受当下，凯文更提出「发哥」是这项运动的推手之一？她们又整理了跑步新手的入门指南，并分享如何让跑步习惯持之以恒的心得，以及减低受伤机会的建议，希望助观众跑出健康与快乐。

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 一路前行粤普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中国生态保护，绿色高品质发展的环保公益纪实节目。透过沉浸式观察新时代环保议题，并邀请胡歌、刘涛、陈龙三位明星亲身参与，共同完成一场绿色低碳生活的行动。

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 三位孩子尝试哄一个BB笑，看到婴儿拿着洋娃娃玩耍，加上穿戴红色的服饰，有两人认为BB是女婴，可会一如所料？有指女生的语言天分较高，五位小朋友随韩文老师学习韩语，男、女学员表现如何？主持洪永城带一位男生感受不一样的扮靓体验，除了转换发型与服装之外，还会修眉、化妆、涂指甲油、喷香水。对于这个新造形，男生本人、其母亲和老师能否接受？回顾三集的性别课题，参与的孩子都有得着，有女生还希望可挑战更激烈的运动！

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤
programme.desc: 今年是人类充满惶恐不安的一年，网络上流传不少大灾难的预言：中东战火、日本超级大地震等，我们的明天究竟会怎样呢？很多人想预知未来，研究它的真假，在网络资讯爆炸的时代，越讲越真，越知道反而越惊，就好像圣经一早预言：『人想起将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体』这一刻，站在文明悬崖上的我们，是否正要见证这古老预言成为现实？在全新一辑的地球大神秘，我们会继续从世界各地神秘事件，探讨各种预言的真确，还会同被称为最准确重要的预言书《圣经》作对比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 为防未知再度出现，太晴继续留在敦贺候命，并趁机参观了敦贺铁路资料馆。阿舞劝良太别再插科打诨，应正视自己的感受，令良太想起爷爷生前说过的话。敌人再度出现，更变成双手钻头，令太晴陷入苦战。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 这集「WORKOUT 2GETHER」带来新意，小朋友先化身指挥家，再扮演动物园内不同动物，谁说运动没趣味？不断默念着拍子，试试挥动双手、画三角形；然后挑战左手画三角形的同时，右手画正方形。这套节拍及协调能力训练，还能顺道操练腿部肌力？每一种动物都有不同神态与步伐，鸭仔主要是蹲着走路，猩猩的双手不停摆动，树懒动作缓慢，蟹是左右移动，扮熊又有甚么要注意？一连串动作，都是针对全身肌耐力做锻练。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 查查林部队粤英
programme.desc: 森林里神秘怪事频生。巨大陷阱出现，栗子消失，昆虫失踪，橡实从天而降！要交由大侦探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly组成的查查林部队调查。牠们未必是最能干的侦探队，但往往能够迎刃而解，揭开大自然奥秘。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子发现，扮猩猩的动作可以令到妈妈笑，甚至可令正在骂人的妈妈息怒。小丸子与同学们在溜冰场遇到一个目中无人的男孩。之后在大家的推波助澜之下，藤木与那个男孩约定了进行溜冰对赛。

programme.title: 潜行天下粤
programme.desc: 《潜行天下》以全球海洋为主题，采用8K超高清摄影机和水下无人机等技术建构沉浸式观影体验，跨越四大洋14国水域拍摄，记录双髻鲨、鲸鲨等海洋生物活动，探密三沙永乐龙洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤

programme.desc: 林晏终于找到赵荀之，准备带他离开时，李昂早已在门口等候，林晏奋力战斗，负伤逃出，遇上韶光兄妹俩后随即晕倒。医师指林晏伤势太严重，无法救治，韶光提议进行缝合，但医师根本不会做，林晏提出让韶光亲自动手…

programme.title: 中国建设银行(亚洲)呈献：攻你上大学粤
programme.desc: 问到「飞」字的部首，《飞常日志II》众演员应该对这字非常熟识，刘颖旋、吴伟豪却不知何谓「部首」！倪乐琳、梁凯晴、朱敏瀚更从输入法角度去拆解？四个选项中，哪一个不是中国的少数民族？周嘉洛因「布朗」似英文译音而拣选，推断可会正确？某人弄不清修辞手法，惊讶其他九人都答对，这挫折令其甚感无瘾……「升中」后第一条题目，「女神」级学生的答案明明与大部份人一样，但强调自己有用脑做选择，还解释得头头是道！

programme.title: 楼盘新视野之走进黄金海湾粤
娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 天气报告粤 及 潮流生活志粤
康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#14粤
programme.desc: 少龙等到达魏国大梁，信陵君与家将来接。龙阳君出城接师傅邹衍及师妹琴清，为封城一事与信陵君争拗，少龙解围令龙阳君生好感。少龙向信陵君坦言知其阴谋，又说想投靠他。连晋向嫪毐拜师遭戏弄。少龙为查秘录下落，故意打草惊蛇，在岸边见貌似秦青的女子，追上去却芳踪杳然。龙阳君安置雏衍及琴清暂住水榭，雏衍夜观星象，发现新圣人将诞生。少龙偷得秘录，信陵君突然折返，少龙逃至水榭并躲在书房，赫见与秦青一模一样的琴清。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 鼻窦炎患者可透过鼻涕颜色分辨严重性，长年累月亦有可能长出鼻瘜肉，盐水洗鼻会否是缓解病情之法？耳鼻喉专科医生再补充，治疗方案上或要施手术以去除鼻瘜肉。正气被指对免疫能力有帮助，但何谓正气？又如何借此改善上呼吸道的健康？粤剧花旦谢晓莹亮相受访，细谈自小对粤剧的热爱，更因参与《合晒合尺》节目而铺垫入行之路。她还一试自组剧团，做班主有甚么困难？「睇𩠌食饭」，李家铤师傅以优质肉材，炒出「泡菜芝士和牛炒饭」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在广州粤
programme.desc: 广州，粤菜发源地之一，广府菜的中心，是每一位食客都无法拒绝的美食圣地。爱吃爱玩的主持人麦包，在广州彻底释放了吃货天性，走遍大街小巷，寻找地道美食：悠闲早茶、西关小吃、新潮佳馔，夜市小摊

programme.title: 单恋双城#18粤
programme.desc: 书舒与式适发现Lois的货售价很高，不明她何以用低价卖货给书舒。式适与恭梓分别来到逼展禛说出真相，展禛打电话求救后展博现身。以荞为电影主题曲录音，岂料老板改用新人主唱，经理人认为唯一反击方法是作好歌。

programme.title: 高朋满座#45粤
programme.desc: 婷成绩滑落，家人协助婷，但却愈帮愈忙，令蕙婷苦不堪言。朋提让婷报读补习班，可是当婷上课回来，众人发现所谓「补习天王」的精读班未能吸收到知识。庆决定陪婷到补习班，更与「补习天王」徐Sir即场比赛中史。

programme.title: 天龙八部#17粤普PG
programme.desc: 萧峰逐渐适应辽阔林野的生活，并与女真族建立了交情。有一天，十多名族人邀萧峰一起打猎，不料遇到辽兵，萧峰以一己之力击退辽兵，成功擒住耶律洪基，其武功及气度令耶律洪基心怀敬佩，二人相谈甚欢，决定结为兄弟。

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 两个女人的房间
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 我的野蛮王妃
programme.desc: 【神级经典韩剧，尹恩惠、朱智勋、金桢勋、宋智孝再现现代宫廷指腹为婚！！】申采静原本只是一名平凡无奇的高中学生，得知爷爷的遗嘱中，她与皇太子李信有婚约在身。因家中债务的原因，在无可奈何的情况完婚。待在皇室的申采静对宫内生活十分反弹，此时海归回来的皇位第二继承者李律及李信前女友闵孝琳的存在，展开错综复杂的故事。

programme.title: 另一种蓝
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 时光之城
programme.desc: 【横跨两国人气演员的偶像剧，张哲瀚携手朴敏英初尝试爱情罗曼史！！】乐观积极的元气少女许真，在前往盖亚影视应征时撞见了当红炸子鸡顾持钧被前女友拒绝的场面。不希望丢脸的事情曝光的顾持钧则从中作梗想赶走许真，却阴错阳差的在盖亚集团二公子林晋修的帮助下，反而成为了顾持钧的助理。朝夕相处、情愫蔓延，却同时卷入了集团的阴谋，两人要如何逃出危机，让有情人终成眷属呢?

programme.title: 坏记忆橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中携陈世娫出演新剧《坏记忆橡皮擦》回归电视剧！！】曾是被看好的网球之星李君，在负伤之后丧失了自尊心，认为自己从人生的主角变成配角。遇上脑研究中心的医生景珠妍，使用了记忆橡皮擦抹去了过去记忆，重生为运动经纪人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初恋。因被篡改的记忆开始的罗曼史，在得知真相后其结局将会如何呢？

programme.title: 珠玉在侧
programme.desc: 【不务正业公子雯珺阴错阳差纳ㄚ环玉荐师徐璐！！】个性古灵精怪的单单单，一心想成为荐玉师却苦无机会，只能帮姐姐单双双卖些假玉，一次交易过程中无意得罪了富家玩绔公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突发危机单单单走投无路入府成为ㄚ环，府邸主人意外是裴沛，单单单也在调笑皆非中与裴沛逐渐相知相惜。

programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 珠玉在侧
programme.desc: 【不务正业公子雯珺阴错阳差纳ㄚ环玉荐师徐璐！！】个性古灵精怪的单单单，一心想成为荐玉师却苦无机会，只能帮姐姐单双双卖些假玉，一次交易过程中无意得罪了富家玩绔公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突发危机单单单走投无路入府成为ㄚ环，府邸主人意外是裴沛，单单单也在调笑皆非中与裴沛逐渐相知相惜。

programme.title: 坏记忆橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中携陈世娫出演新剧《坏记忆橡皮擦》回归电视剧！！】曾是被看好的网球之星李君，在负伤之后丧失了自尊心，认为自己从人生的主角变成配角。遇上脑研究中心的医生景珠妍，使用了记忆橡皮擦抹去了过去记忆，重生为运动经纪人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初恋。因被篡改的记忆开始的罗曼史，在得知真相后其结局将会如何呢？

programme.desc: 猪猪侠与同伴接收到来自九霄星的求救信号，尽管他们已经失去了强大的超能力，但热心肠的猪猪们仍然义无反顾地再次启航，前往那个充满未知数的陌生星球。来到九霄星后，猪猪们看到了整个星球的地表都被灼热的岩浆覆盖，而空中竟然悬浮着许多壮观宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，这些天空之城正在陆续失去能让它们悬浮的五灵元素，面临坠毁的威胁。猪猪侠等人寻找背后的原因，并耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪恶力量，使出浑身解数拯救天空之城。一场守护正义、保护天空之城的全新冒险之旅开始啦。

programme.title: 陷入纯情(完)
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成郑敬淏爱与复仇的心脏奇迹】没血没泪的冷酷企业代表姜敏浩，有著先天扩张性心藏病，面对随时有可能死亡的恐惧感，做起事来比谁都还心狠手辣。幼年父亲去世时，叔叔夺走了父亲的公司，高层主管们也纷纷选择背叛，庞大压力下母亲选择轻生留下敏浩一人。复仇心的驱使下，他成为GoldPartners的投资专家，同时也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大债权人团体，看似成功之际，却心脏病发命在旦夕，所幸出现心脏捐赠者，重生的他因细胞记忆而变得温暖，甚至对仇人女儿产生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的疗愈爱情故事。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高银与朴海镇领衔，知名主角群展现校园青春浪漫！！】大学新生洪雪面对完美又腹黑的刘正学长，因独特魅力逐渐受他吸引。随著两人情意渐浓，刘正的神秘性个性和控制欲逐渐浮出水面，两人微妙的心理战，以及性格不羁同学的白仁浩再洪雪身边守候，三人的矛盾、最终洪雪情归何处?

programme.title: 韩国小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 纸之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主妇为小王盗用公款!寻找自由只是为了空虚的爱?】讲述家庭主妇刘怡华（金瑞亨饰）在婚姻中得不到丈夫关心，日复一日过著枯燥乏味的生活，她开始复职到银行上班后，想找回自身的价值。原本颇得客户信赖，不过在一次意外挪用客户的钱后，她从中尝到自由的滋味，接著陷入无法自拔的漩涡中。《夏娃的丑闻》裕善将饰演她的闺蜜柳秋天、《邪门》徐令姬饰演想跻身上流社会的家庭主妇。此片改编自日本小说，其日本电视及电影版在日本得奖无数。

programme.title: 现在开始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操纵幻术的魔术师朴海镇×通灵女警秦基周，灵异喜剧Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔术师车次雄，不仅能操纵幻术，还能使唤鬼魂，这群「幽灵助手」是他的得力伙伴。热血女警高瑟海，拥有通灵能力，她对灵异现象毫不畏惧。两人因一起调查超自然案件而结盟，一边与鬼神合作，一边大展魔术与正义力量。当喜剧、灵异与调查结合，爱情与真相也心动牵引。

programme.title: 落花时节又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.title: 小欢喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.title: 小欢喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. The Teletubbies have fun getting dizzy on the Tubby Spinny.

programme.title: Finger of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous "Finger of Doom", a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage. A heartless tycoon plans to take over the orphanage for its land but has to deal with Seventh Sister's magical powers as she aims to protect it from falling into his hands!

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Duel Of Fist
programme.desc: Fan Ke discovers at his father's deathbed that he has a half-brother, Wenlie, in Thailand. He goes to find Wenlie, who became a boxer to support his sick mother. Following their encounter, the two got involved in the underworld of boxing match gambling.

programme.title: Danger has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner. When his best friend, Bobby begins investigating recent murder cases committed by Kam, he discovers that the mastermind behind these cases is actually his superintendent.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his "Crazy Lo Han Fist" improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from "Fake Ghost Catchers" Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - "Black Leopard". Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of "Black Leopard", except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the "Full Moon Scimitar", on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Li Cheng Ying's father was set up and killed by his old friend Ling Hao. Li, who has learnt "Shaolin Hand Lock" from his father, is on a mission to avenge his death. He works as an undercover guard at Ling's house where he meets his long-lost brother, and the two team up to take revenge for their father against Ling.

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own "Eight Diagram Pole Fight" and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder happens, and the suspects get killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy over two generations.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation...

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei's concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&amp;B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter's company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: The Hub With Wang Guan
programme.desc: The Hub with Wang Guan covers hot-button geopolitical and economic issues, as well as interesting stories and trends in culture, education, technology and lifestyle. programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Please Hold While We Connect You
programme.desc: In the wake of the previous episode, the magical creatures have all vanished and the world at large has gone gray. Desperate to fix things, the crew travels to the Magical Realm to confront the omniscient Great Watcher, who was a tempting offer for Yi. The kids manage to retrieve creatures, but being back in the human world is sapping them of their magical energy.

programme.title: Abominable and The Invisible City S1 - Everest Returns
programme.desc: Following the events of the feature, Yi struggles to recreate her violin magic without Everest. While her mom and NaiNai prepare for the grand opening of their family dumpling shop, Yi, Jin, and Peng discover that Yi’s violin has attracted a magical bird-like creature, Fenghuang, who needs their help. Yi’s music also calls on Everest, who returns to join the crew and find Fenghuang a suitable home.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Eep-Over Thunkytown
programme.desc: When Eep has the first-ever sleepover, scary noises and shadows send the girls screaming out of the cave; Thunk saves the day when Bear Owls invade.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Costly Conundrum of the Calamitous Claylossus
programme.desc: George and Harold transform the school's mysterious student into a giant clay monster who turns the entire town into clay

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - D-Stroy
programme.desc: DStructs quest to find the location of the supercharger leaves him in a tight situation

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Bunker Break-InTo Catch a Critter
programme.desc: When Branch loses to Poppy at Capture the Flag, he challenges her to break into his bunker and steal Gary, to prove her abilities. Poppy organizes a whacky heist with the help of the Snack Pack. When Smidge accidentally loses some of the critters Milton cares for, she must try and retrieve them from Trolls Forest.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - Palomino Bluffs Riding Academy
programme.desc: On their first day at Palomino Bluffs, the girls are determined to make a good impression. Cue the beachfront race - and a daring rescue!

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S3 - Lions' Pride (Part 2)
programme.desc: Voltron must battle the biggest and baddest Robeast yet before it is drained of its Quintessence

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - At Odds With The Pod
programme.desc: Birch, Sandra, Liam and Raffi all have very different plans for how to spend their day, unfortunately they're also on a pod project with a fast approaching deadline. Instead of consulting with each other, each of the four kids follows his or her own path until it looks like academic disaster in inevitable.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Accept No Substitutes
programme.desc: The so-called maintenance of Mr. Towes' desk combined with an opinionated new substitute teacher have Birch convinced her favourite-teacher-ever has been exiled. What Birch doesn't know is that Mr. Towes is just preferring privacy and the new sub is a good friend.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Fish Fiasco
programme.desc: Competition gets in the way of raising awareness for an endangered species when Birch and Sandra take up the exact same cause. What starts out as a campaign to help the environment turns into a full-blown fish fiasco as the two girls refuse to cooperate.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Birch's Trial
programme.desc: Circumstantial evidence puts Birch in the hot seat. A caricature of a less popular student is discovered and all eyes turn to resident Manganaki Birch Small. Soon court is in session and Birch is making her case before a jury of her peers. But proving her innocence isn't enough; Birch wants to know who's behind the pen.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Flowertot Fairies
programme.desc: The twins are sure they have seen fairies in the garden and set out on a hunt to prove it to Fifi. Will they find any?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Dandelions
programme.desc: The twins inadvertently ruin Fifi's garden while playing a game. Can they and the other tots make it better before Fifi finds out?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Compost Chaos
programme.desc: Primrose can't make her garden grow and turns to Fifi for advice. She is amazed when Fifi points out that you need to water and weed a garden. And surely she can't really mean putting that yucky compost everywhere can she?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Bumble's Afraid Of The Dark
programme.desc: Primrose and Violet are having a sleepover. When Bumble admits that he is scared of the dark, the tots try everything to stop him from being afraid

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Count On Fifi
programme.desc: Fifi and Bumble deliver lots of delicious honey to Poppy's stall. They lose a pot on the way and there isn't enough to go round. Can they find the missing pot, or will Stingo have to go without his honey for tea?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Poppy The Line Dancing Queen
programme.desc: Poppy is having a line dancing party, but none of the other flowertots know how to do it. Will any of them learn to dance in time or will Poppy have to cancel the party?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - King Stingo
programme.desc: Aunt Tulip has lost Grubby again. When Stingo finds him, he asks to be made King as a reward. It isn't long before he has gone too far and the tots are all fed up with his demands. Can Fifi get life in the garden back to normal?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Hide And Seek
programme.desc: The tots are playing hide and seek and the winner will get Fifi's delicious jam tarts. Who will win, Stingo and Slugsy are sure it will be them!

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Takes A Road Trip
programme.desc: On the looooong drive to Grandma's house, Olivia finds ways to pass the time. She imagines her family traveling in style, as she pilots her very own jumbo jet-Olivia Air! By the time they arrive at Grandma's, Olivia's had so much fun that the discomfort of the road trip has been forgotten.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Goes International
programme.desc: When asked to give a presentation for her class's International Day. Olivia can't decide which country to choose. Being Olivia she invents her own country -Olivitania -where cupcakes are the national food and the national anthem sounds suspiciously like Puccini.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Dak's lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leyla's overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

programme.desc: Lured into an empty hotel where a baby has supposedly gone missing, the team is trapped by Crispin Biscuits, a chaotic British schoolboy baby who’s been hired to wreck Boss and Tina’s lives. Crispin puts the new company’s loyalty to a test in a series of fiendish puzzling mind games, all with the threat of constant balloon popping (horrible for baby ears!)

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Moon Shot
programme.desc: Our team’s startup company and their rivals at Baby Corp get in a "Space Race", competing to see who can make the cutest kiddie-pretend "moon landing" for a baby - a spectacle sure to bring in a bounty of Baby Love. With both companies pouring their resources into a simulated space take off, tempers and sabotage are running hot, and the scrappy little startup is in danger of getting crushed by their big business competitor.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Frantic Fury of the Fearsome Furculees
programme.desc: Tired of the Melvins ruling the school, the boys realize that they need Mr. Krupp to make the school at least bearable. Unfortunately, Krupp has run off to Ecuador to look for a fabled fountain. So the boys form the M.I.S.F.A.R.T.S. - Mega Incredible Search Force Adventure Rescue Team Squad - to travel to Ecuador and bring Krupp back, whether he wants it or not.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Harmful Horrors of the Harrowing Hiveschool
programme.desc: After injecting all the teachers with bee DNA, the Melvins run the new "hivemind" of the school. But Ms. Ribble is accidently injected with too much "Bee- NA" and becomes the queen bee, overpowering the Melvins' control. George, Harold and the recently re-hired Vice Principal Krupp must work with the Melvins and stop her from turning everyone into her Zombees.

programme.desc: Our team battles Rafaela’s mind-controlled crowd. They soon discover that Rafaela’s true plan is to steal the spy plane. Tony deduces that Rafaela isn’t doing all of this for the money - she’s doing it for family.
